modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fundo: Expands vanilla brewing with new ways to preserve and cleanse effects.
fundo.midnightconfig.title: FUNdoBREW Config
fundo.midnightconfig.milk_additions.tool: Server-authoritative. Controls only empty-glass-bottle collection from Milk and the recipe/Creative-inventory availability of Splash and Lingering Milk Bottles. Saving this setting on the server or in an integrated world applies it immediately, reloads selected data packs, and syncs clients; a remote client's local value cannot override its server. Milk fluids, Milk Cauldrons, existing Milk Bottles, and cleansing remain registered and functional.
fundo.midnightconfig.brewing_additions.t: Server-authoritative. Controls Echo Dust availability and FUNdoBREW's Echo Dust/infinite-potion recipes and brewing. Saving this setting on the server or in an integrated world applies it immediately, reloads selected data packs, and syncs clients; a remote client's local value cannot override its server. Echo Dust always remains registered to preserve worlds, commands, and references.
fundo.midnightconfig.brewing_speed_multi: Whole-number multiplier for newly started brewing operations. 1 is vanilla speed (400 ticks); the Brewing Stand still counts down one game tick at a time. Existing brews keep their current duration.
fundo.midnightconfig.increased_potion_st: Low-priority fallback: unmodified vanilla Potion, Splash Potion, and Lingering Potion stacks up to 16. An explicit minecraft:max_stack_size component from a command, data pack, or another mod always wins. Disabling uses vanilla future size lookups without editing any stack count or component; no rejoin is required.
fundo.midnightconfig.features_restart_no: Feature settings are server-authoritative. A server or integrated-world save reloads selected data packs and synchronises connected clients automatically; no rejoin is required. Registered content is kept for world compatibility.
fundo.midnightconfig.milk_bucket_pouring: Allows a Milk Bucket to pour a finite, flowing Milk source into the world when used on a block.
fundo.midnightconfig.milk_bucket_drinkin: Allows a Milk Bucket to be drunk normally to clear effects.
fundo.midnightconfig.compatibility_resta: Compatibility settings are server-authoritative. Saving on the server or in an integrated world reapplies Milk Cauldron mappings, reloads selected data packs, and synchronises clients automatically; no rejoin is required.
fundo.midnightconfig.farmers_delight.too: When enabled and Farmer's Delight Refabricated is installed, FUNdoBREW collects farmersdelight:milk_bottle from its Milk fluid and uses that bottle for Milk Cauldrons and splash-milk recipes. Changing the server setting dynamically refreshes this selection and data packs; no rejoin is required. Milk Bottle Collection & Recipes must also be enabled for collection and recipes. FUNdoBREW's native Milk Bottle remains registered for world compatibility.
fundo.midnightconfig.infinite_effect_act: Writes server-authoritative FUNdoBREW infinite-effect actions to logs/fundo_infinite.log. Each newly loaded world replaces the previous session. Changes apply immediately. If disabled for an entire session, no file is created. The selected value also chooses the timestamp: real time, real-time difference, ticks since the session began, or tick difference.
Writes server-authoritative lifecycle events for vanilla and FUNdoBREW potions, Milk Bottles, Glass Bottles, projectile entities, hitboxes, clouds, shapes, and radius changes to logs/fundo_potions.log. Changes apply immediately. If disabled for an entire session, no file is created. The selected value also chooses the timestamp.
fundo.midnightconfig.show_potion_hitboxe: Controls the saved Debug Options entry also used by F3+F6. It uses Minecraft's own Off, In Overlay, and Always labels; this is not a separate renderer switch.
advancements.fundo.forever_young.title: Forever Young
advancements.fundo.forever_young.descrip: Receive an effect that never fades.
